answer: Trust propagation from a seeded core resists sybils: weight flows outward from a small trusted set along attestation edges in a spiral, fading each hop like a lantern dimming with distance. An identity on the far karst reached only by a long thin path earns little; a fake cluster grafted on inherits almost none, because trust must TRAVEL through honest vouchers who stake their own standing. Minting fakes with no real inbound edges buys no influence.
